title: The I2C Communication Bus
summary: Network dozens of sensors and displays using only two wires: SDA and SCL! Master addresses and bus scanning.

steps.title: Why Buses Save Wires
steps.markdownContent: Connecting a display, clock, and accelerometer individually would use up all 14 pins! With **I2C** (Inter-Integrated Circuit), all devices share just two wires: `SDA` (Data) and `SCL` (Clock).

steps.title: Device Hex Addresses
steps.markdownContent: Every I2C module has a unique street address, like `0x27` for LCDs or `0x68` for Real Time Clocks. Arduino calls out the address before sending data!

steps.title: The Wire Library
steps.markdownContent: Include `<Wire.h>` and call `Wire.begin();`. On Arduino Uno, SDA is on pin `A4` and SCL is on pin `A5`.
